title: This US company is repurposing old EV batteries in Nevada to power AI data centres. This could solve one of AI’s biggest problems
description: A new trend is emerging as retired electric vehicle batteries are repurposed to fuel artificial intelligence data centres. Retaining considerable capacity, these batteries offer a budget-friendly energy storage alternative. In Nevada, a pioneering initiative combines solar energy with numerous second-life battery systems, illustrating their effectiveness for intensive computing needs. As these projects grow, they will provide further insights into the durability of these energy solutions for major AI infrastructures.
